stages.label: Signal → Idea
stages.evidence: S19 signal sweep: Korean communities trade price/side-effect/yo-yo logs.

stages.label: Validate (cheap test)
stages.evidence: Pull score 4/5. Manual logging + price-shopping confirmed; fake-door conversion still UNKNOWN.

stages.label: Spec (PRD / flows / data / APIs)
stages.evidence: Data model + cost-per-kg / rate / scenario formulas; fully client-side, no API.

stages.label: Feasibility (stack / effort / risk)
stages.evidence: Prototype ~1.5d, real MVP ~1wk. Medical-liability risk mitigated by cost-only framing.

stages.label: Interactive prototype (real logic)
stages.evidence: Working React prototype: cost-per-kg, weekly check-ins, side-effect flags, scenario math, continue/taper/stop.

stages.label: Go / No-Go
stages.evidence: GO — build real MVP after one live fake-door test.
